title: Puttering Pebble Cuttlefish
statement: A plum-sized cuttlefish with translucent fins and a flickering punctuation-patterned coat lives above black sand, moon-white pebbles, and one crooked arch of blue glass, all lit like a library after dark. It spends its afternoons arranging the pebbles into elaborate spirals, then deliberately nudges one out of place and hovers over the resulting problem in a blush of delighted gold.
